en.title: Time expressions for the past
en.summary: Time expressions place an action in the past.

paragraphs: Time expressions place an action in the past: yesterday, last week, ago and in 2010.
Use the simple past with finished times. Use ago after a length of time. Use for and since with the present perfect, and just, already and yet with it too.

blocks.html:
